title: Your Highness, Stop Holding Back, You've Crushed Your Prayer Beads
author: Caomei Bu Shi Zheme Chi Da
synopsis:
Adapted short drama "Crossing the Abyss of Dust" currently open for reservation.
[True master-manipulator sea-mariner beauty × paranoid, crazy, ascetic crown prince, 1v1, male lead goes crazy and falls in love first, super sweet and high flirt]
"I cultivate Buddhism and keep away from women."
"Then what was that pressing against this subject last night... Your Highness?"
Transmigrated into the Marquis's legitimate daughter who was pua-ed to death, Su Yaoyao looked at her plump, seductive figure in the mirror and smiled.
The original owner was truly wasting heaven's gift; this waist is slim and legs are long, with full breasts, yet she was bound so tightly her complexion turned sallow, and she was even called "fat" by her fiance, the second prince?
She is a max-level sea-mariner! Men? There are only men she doesn't want to flirt with, none she can't catch.
Ripping off the chest binder, she returned as an earthly siren.
She turned around and started flirting with the scumbag's older brother, the legendary pure and desireless crown prince and Buddhist devotee.
Everyone said the crown prince kept away from women and would sooner or later convert to Buddhism.
Yet in the dim ancestral hall, he pinned her against the scriptural texts, the prayer beads pressing against her snow-white skin, his breathing burning hot:
"Su Yaoyao, is this what you want?"
She hooked his lapel with an alluring smile,
"Your Highness's Buddha saves all sentient beings, but can he save himself?"
Later, the scumbag second prince regretted to tears and begged for reconciliation. Leaning in the crown prince's embrace, she played with the prayer beads nonchalantly:
"Too late, now... call me sister-in-law."
His Highness the aloof Buddhist prince murmured beside her ear, paranoid yet affectionate:
"Yaoyao, if there is a hell with you, I gladly welcome it."
The aloof Buddhist prince sinks into depravity while fully awake.
[Reading Guide]
1. Female lead is a true sea-mariner / master manipulator beauty, seductive and teasing, absolutely refuses to take grievances.
2. Male lead appears as an aloof Buddhist on the surface, but is actually paranoid and crazy, breaking his vows solely for the female lead.
